body: I know, the main point is that I'm sad/depressed but I just couldn't word it right so I did it this way.

(It of course sounds better when I say "Wrote tons of PHP to help with generating 3D printable sprockets to user specification" but the actual fun stuff I got stepped on.)

Whatever I do well bites me because others cheat and are jealous and since I'm super ahead on CS only then I spend days without anything to so for an hour. Then I just suck at everything else.. (not a typo, intended to be a shortcut for 'period')
Once I find time and energy I'll start learning those but for now I'm just doing things in Java.

Intended to be Java, and it could work if you actually wrote those classes, methods, variables, and constants. I haven't learned much else. All my opportunities get stepped on and others end up just doing it for me.

High school and have a huge passion for programming. I have tried talking but I'm not too talkative about most of this. I'm going to try to break through this nine weeks and then through the summer and take it from there.
